body.name: profiled null score and variance
body.construction: \(\widehat m_N(\theta)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\sum_{s=1}^K\widehat a_{sx}(\theta)\{\overline r_{sx1}(\theta)-\overline r_{sx0}(\theta)\}\) and \(\widehat V_N(\theta)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\sum_{s=1}^K\widehat a_{sx}(\theta)^2\widehat q_{sx}(\theta)/\{n_s\max(\widehat p_s(x),N^{-1})\}\).
